description: This file contains implementations for MIOpen-based CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) loss functions, with conditional compilation depending on whether ROCm (GPU computing platform) support is enabled. It includes functions to check whether MIOpen should be used based on input tensor properties and implementations of the loss computations, though the primary loss functions currently raise errors when MIOpen support is not enabled.
